Package index

Absolute risk

Build an absolute risk model and apply it to covariate and SNP profiles.

computeAbsoluteRisk()
Build and apply an absolute risk model
computeAbsoluteRiskSplitInterval()
Absolute risk with a model that changes at a cut age
print(<icare>) print(<icareSplit>) summary(<icare>) summary(<icareSplit>) plot(<icare>) plot(<icareSplit>)
Print, summarize and plot absolute risk results

Model validation

Calibration and discrimination in a cohort or a nested case-control study.

ModelValidation()
Validate an absolute risk model in a cohort or a sample from a cohort
plotModelValidation()
Plot the results of a model validation
print(<icareValid>) plot(<icareValid>)
Print and plot model validation results
